description: Every \(L(M)\)-sentence is a named instance of an \(L\)-formula with a finite parameter tuple from \(M\). The formula can be chosen literal exactly when the sentence is literal, and quantifier-free exactly when the sentence is quantifier-free.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.sentence_is_namedFormula.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  (γ : (L.withConstants M).Sentence) :
  ∃ n φ a,
    γ = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Diagrams.namedFormula φ a ∧
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.IsLiteral γ ↔
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.IsLiteral φ) ∧
        (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF γ ↔ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF φ)
